meta.name: modern_hellenist_assault
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist coastal metropolis under monster assault

programs.brief: A colossal multi-tentacled sea leviathan surging from the ocean waves, with bioluminescent scales, armored dorsal crests, and a massive maw snapping toward the coastal city.
A towering modern neoclassical bronze-and-quartz colossus monument retrofitted into a heavy coastal artillery emplacement aimed out over the bay.
An amphibious spined sea beast climbing onto the shore and quays, with glistening scales, taloned forelimbs, and razor-sharp fins.

tokens.event_direction: giant sea monsters breach the harbour water and assault the coastal promenade and waterfront districts
tokens.infra: barricade_line across the waterfront avenue; emergency perimeter cordoning the docklands
tokens.terrain: a grand neoclassical modern city stepped above a wide coastal bay
tokens.icons: modern skyscrapers fronted with classical colonnades and porticos, wide marble plazas with modern transit, colossal sea beasts emerging from the sea, damaged waterfront piers
